qty_basis: minimum 10-20 nuts plus extras for practice; exact thread by old sample
buy_instruction: Buy brake-rated steel tube nuts for 4.75 mm / 3/16 in automotive brake line. Likely Toyota-style M10x1 inverted/double-flare nuts, but confirm old wheel-cylinder, hose, tee, and master/proportioning port threads before final use.
sample_match_or_release_gate: Tube nut fits 3/16 tube, thread/pitch and sealing seat match old Toyota port, hex can be worked with line wrench, and practice double/inverted flare seals without bottoming or thread damage.
reject_if: Compression fitting, plumbing brass fitting, single-flare-only fitting, ISO bubble-only fitting, unknown thread/seat, loose thread engagement, or seller cannot confirm brake-line use.
notes: Buy a spare set even if the Altivox kit includes fittings. Use extras for practice flares and future service; final installation still remains old-sample controlled.

qty_basis: 1 old rear assembly plus photos and measurements
primary_buy_link: Montgomery Road Lahore: auto-control-cable, clutch cable, speedometer cable, handbrake cable maker
backup_links: Bilal Ganj for used splitter/yoke hardware|truck/bus cable maker if car cable shop cannot swage heavy cable|SNA Industries as out-of-city cable/brake lead
buy_instruction: Ask for: old Toyota Land Cruiser rear handbrake cable, splitter/equalizer type, one pull cable splitting to both rear wheels. Copy the old cable exactly; use new automotive multi-strand cable, new lined outer sheath where fitted, proper swaged ends, new boots/sleeves if available, and new springs/clips by sample.
sample_match_or_release_gate: Bench pull test before fitting: equalizer moves freely, both outputs move together, cable returns when released, ends do not slip, adjuster threads run smoothly, and brackets/stops match old samples.
reject_if: Shop proposes welding the equalizer solid, using wire rope clamps as final ends, making only a generic straight cable, omitting sheath stops, or cannot swage/crimp heavy automotive cable ends.
notes: This is likely locally available because it is an auto-control-cable fabrication job, not a hydraulic/brake-line job.

component: Rear parking-brake rear equalizer / splitter cable assembly
qty_basis: 1 rear splitter/equalizer assembly feeding both rear wheels, plus any missing branch sections
primary_buy_link: Montgomery Road Lahore auto-control-cable / clutch-speedometer cable fabricator; take old sample and photos
backup_links: Bilal Ganj used Toyota/Land Cruiser brake hardware for yoke/equalizer pieces|Fine Auto Montgomery Road Land Cruiser desk for old-sample parts lead|NDE parts-on-demand for 46410-60092 reference lead|SNA Industries auto-control-cable/brake hose lead
buy_instruction: Do not hunt imported catalog pages first. Take the old rear handbrake section to a local auto-control-cable maker and ask for a copy of the rear parking-brake equalizer/splitter cable assembly: one pull input feeding left/right rear wheel cables, with correct sheath lengths, bracket stops, adjuster thread, clevis/yoke ends, and swaged cable ends.
sample_match_or_release_gate: Splitter/equalizer floats and pulls both rear wheel levers evenly; left/right cable free lengths match old layout; sheath stop/groove fits original brackets; adjuster has usable travel; cable releases fully through suspension droop.
reject_if: Bicycle/motorcycle light cable, soldered ends only, loose screw clamps, weak swages, missing yoke/equalizer, wrong bracket stops, or cable that pulls one wheel before the other.
notes: This is the part the user means: the back handbrake splitter/equalizer section that connects both rear wheels. It is locally makeable as an auto-control-cable job, but the ends and equalizer hardware are the critical part.

component: Rear handbrake yoke/equalizer, clevises, pins, clips, and lever hardware
qty_basis: as removed: yoke/equalizer/splitter pieces plus both wheel lever connection sets
primary_buy_link: Bilal Ganj used Toyota/Land Cruiser brake hardware, then Montgomery Road brake/cable shops by old sample
backup_links: Fine Auto Montgomery Road Land Cruiser desk|NDE parts-on-demand|Daraz/PakWheels only for generic clips/springs after dimensions are known
buy_instruction: If the cable fabricator cannot supply the metal splitter/equalizer/yoke pieces, get those by old sample from Bilal Ganj or a Land Cruiser brake parts desk. Then have the cable shop swage the new cable around the correct hardware.
sample_match_or_release_gate: Clevis/yoke widths, pin diameters, clip retention, adjuster thread, lever holes, and equalizer movement match old hardware and do not bind.
reject_if: Generic wire clamp, drilled/bent brake levers, soft pins, missing safety clips, welded fixed splitter, or hardware that prevents the equalizer from balancing left/right pull.
notes: Treat catalog rebuild kits as content references only. The practical Lahore path is local used hardware plus cable fabrication by sample.

qty_basis: as counted: external cable/lever springs plus any parking-brake lever return springs not in drum kit
buy_instruction: Replace all handbrake springs. If the Centric rear drum kit does not include the external handbrake cable/lever springs, buy them locally by old sample dimensions.
sample_match_or_release_gate: Free length, wire diameter, coil diameter, hook orientation, and installed tension match old layout; levers return fully without dragging shoes.
reject_if: Hardware-store spring with weak tension, wrong hook angle, too long/short, rubs drum/hub, or stretches at first pull.
notes: Do not reuse stretched or rusty handbrake springs.

component: Parking-brake adjuster / star-wheel style parts if separate
qty_basis: as fitted per side or central adjuster depending actual layout
buy_instruction: Inspect adjuster threads, star wheel, lever interface, handedness, and cable adjustment travel. Buy only if missing, seized, badly worn, or not included in the Centric hardware kit.
sample_match_or_release_gate: Thread, handedness, length, shoe contact points, and adjuster access match the opened drum/backing-plate layout.
reject_if: Wrong handedness, wrong thread pitch, wrong shoe contact profile, or requires changing the backing plate/shoe web.
notes: The Cruiser Corps adjuster link is a reference route; local sample-match is preferred.

qty_basis: as counted at original route points
buy_instruction: Use existing P-clips/U-clips/retainers first. Buy only missing location-specific clips/sleeves/grommets after counting old route points and measuring cable/tube OD and bracket holes.

notes: This supports the axle-side tidy work while the rear brakes are apart.
